appearance.silhouette: 나무 뒤에서 활을 겨누는 산채 궁수, 검은 팔끈과 짧은 활
appearance.visualIdentity: 가볍고 민첩한 성인 한국인 산채 궁수. 짧은 활, 검은 팔끈, 소형 화살통만으로 매복형 원거리 적을 읽히며 나무나 풍경은 MAIN 실루엣에 포함하지 않는다.
appearance.equipmentLock: 짧은 활 정확히 1개를 screen-left 손에 들고 screen-right 손은 빈 시위 가까이에 둔다. 검은 팔끈은 screen-right 아래팔에 정확히 1개, 화살통은 screen-right 뒤허리에 정확히 1개이며 화살은 5개만 보인다. 근접 무기와 방패는 없다.

style.profile: ProjectBS rough low-density open-ink mok-seon pastel
style.linework: rough sparse near-black open ink contour
style.color: restrained low-density muted forest and earth pastel wash

singleImageSpecification.pose: neutral readable full-body ready stance, bow lowered and not firing, both feet and equipment visible
singleImageSpecification.framing: centered full figure with safe empty margins; no crop

requiredElements: screen-right 뒤허리의 화살통 정확히 1개와 보이는 화살 정확히 5개
prohibitedElements: 장비 좌우 반전 또는 수량 변경

phases: f0 grounded ranged ready: short bow in screen-left hand, exactly five arrows visible in screen-right rear-waist quiver
f1 screen-right hand reaches to the five-arrow quiver while knees and pelvis set
f2 exactly one existing arrow is drawn, leaving four in quiver; five total character-owned arrows remain visible
f3 arrow nocks and torso counter-rotates; bow remains in screen-left hand
f4 full draw and aim with grounded weight transfer; one nocked arrow plus four quiver arrows
f5 release boundary: nocked arrow leaves the character sprite and becomes gameplay-projectile responsibility; no flying arrow or trail; four remain in quiver
f6 empty-string recoil and controlled bow follow-through; no loose arrow
f7 neutral ready-compatible recovery with four quiver arrows; canonical fifth arrow may restore only at gameplay state transition, never as an in-sequence pop
animationRequests.motion: one long-range hidden-arrow shot derived from the basic skill; connected feet, knees, pelvis, ribcage, shoulders and back load, not arm-only drawing
equipmentLocks: exactly one short bow remains in screen-left hand
screen-right hand alone draws and releases
exactly one black armband remains on screen-right forearm
exactly one quiver remains at screen-right rear waist
canonical inventory begins with exactly five arrows; only one existing arrow may transfer from quiver to nock and then to gameplay projectile ownership
no sword, shield, longbow, duplicate arrow, bow-hand swap, or whole-body mirror
animationRequests.styleEffects: short body-attached broken black/charcoal dry-brush tension behind draw shoulder during f3-f5 and sparse muted forest/earth pastel pressure at planted feet; no visible projectile, projectile trail, magic, aura, detached effect, or cell crossing

phases: f0 anatomical LEFT contact
f1 LEFT compression
f2 LEFT-to-RIGHT passing
f3 distinct up/extension
f4 anatomical RIGHT contact opposite f0
f5 RIGHT compression opposite f1
f6 RIGHT-to-LEFT passing opposite f2
f7 distinct up/extension closing into f0
animationRequests.motion: agile screen-right scout run at movement scale 1.0 with compact stride, planted push-off, pelvis compression and ribcage counter-rotation; game root fixed, no camera pan
equipmentLocks: single short bow remains safely controlled in screen-left hand
screen-right forearm retains one black armband
single quiver remains at screen-right rear waist with exactly five secured arrows
no loose or nocked arrow, hand swap, whole-body mirror, duplication, detachment, sword, shield, or longbow
animationRequests.styleEffects: restrained body-attached broken ink echoes behind feet, bow edge and clothing only; sparse grounded forest/earth pastel pressure; no attack trail, projectile, detached speed streak, floor cloud, magic, or neighboring-cell effect

phases: f0 grounded ambush-ready stance with bow lowered
f1 shallow inhale and tiny shoulder rise
f2 subtle weight shift through hips and knees
f3 exhale as screen-right hand settles near but does not touch the string
f4 brief screen-right path scan without aiming or drawing
f5 clothing, bow and quiver settle cleanly into f0
animationRequests.motion: restrained living ranged idle with both feet planted, subtle breathing and alert gaze; not an attack wind-up, arrow handling, aiming, or walking-in-place
equipmentLocks: one short bow in screen-left hand
one black armband on screen-right forearm
one screen-right rear-waist quiver containing exactly five secured arrows
no loose, held, nocked, or drawn arrow
no mirror, hand swap, duplication, disappearance, detachment, sword, shield, or longbow

combat.roleIntent: 후열에서 플레이어 이동을 압박하는 원거리 적

notes: 핵앤슬래시 다수 몬스터 전투 기준으로 공격 스코어 50%, 체력 스코어 25% 보정 적용. NPC 기본 회복 스탯은 사용하지 않는다.
